From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Aurora Financial - Security questionnaire kickoff & next actions

Hi Alice / team,

Thanks again for the call earlier — useful to map scope. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

1) High-level scope (from our call)
- Products: Aurora Payments (primary), Aurora Ledger (limited pilot)
- Data types: payment card pseudonymized tokens, customer PII for ACH processing (HIPAA not broadly applicable except a small healthcare vertical you mentioned)
- Regions: US primary, some EU customers (data residency follow-up below)

2) Compliance posture (Redwood)
- We are SOC 2 Type II (in-scope controls for security & availability). Redacted SOC 2 summary attached (Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf).
- We support KMS-backed encryption at rest; customer-managed KMS on Redwood Private deployments (we can provide specifics).

3) Questionnaire path
- Our recommendation: SIG Core / SIG Lite as the primary intake for vendor questionnaire. We can also accept CAIQ or your custom spreadsheet but SIG helps standardize evidence collection. I've attached a prefill template (Redwood_SIG_prefill.xlsx) — fills the low-friction fields to accelerate your review.

4) Clarifying questions for your team (please confirm):
- Do you want SIG Core (full) or SIG Lite (reduced) for initial triage?
- Which Aurora product(s) and environments are in-scope for this review (prod only or staging/dev as well)?
- Is there a procurement/PO timeline we should coordinate with?
- Point of contact for evidence (receiving attachments & granting access): name/email + preferred transfer method (Box/Drive/SFTP).

Next steps I propose:
- Alice / Bob: confirm preferred questionnaire type (SIG Core/CAIQ/custom) and point person for evidence transfer.
- Redwood: once form selected, we will return the prefilled SIG within 3 business days and schedule a 30-minute follow-up to align on any outstanding evidence.
- Target: initial prefill + SOC2 summary back by EOD Thu, Jun 17 if we get confirmation by EOD Tue, Jun 15.

Attachments: Redwood_SIG_prefill.xlsx (prefill template), Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf (redacted SOC2 highlights).

If helpful I can also pull a short architecture sketch showing where customer data resides in our hosted flow.

Thanks,

Karthik Iyer

Thanks Karthik — great summary and timely. A few items to clarify from our side: 

- Questionnaire preference: SIG Core would be ideal, but if SIG Lite will get us to a faster procurement decision we can start there as long as we have a path to full SIG.
- In-scope: production only for Aurora Payments; Aurora Ledger is out of scope for this round.
- HIPAA: confirmed — a small subset of transactions tied to our healthcare payer customers will be in scope (we'll flag those records separately).
- Data residency: Aurora is US-headquartered; however, we have EU customers and need to understand where EU customer data is processed and whether Redwood offers EU region hosting.
- Evidence contact: I am the initial contact, but please loop Bob (security) for technical evidence and procurement questions. Bob's email is bob.liu@aurorafin.com.

Timeline: SIG Lite start is fine; we'll expect a prefill within a week. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide KMS encryption details (key ownership options) and retained-logs duration? Also please confirm whether your SOC 2 report can be shared under NDA.

Appreciate the attachments — I'll upload Aurora_scope.xlsx (attached) with a brief scope matrix and contact info.

Cheers,

Alice Danvers
Sr. Security Manager, Aurora Financial
alice.danvers@aurorafin.com

Alice — thanks for the quick clarifications. A few technical follow-ups from Redwood security so we can scope evidence and map to SIG sections: 

1) Encryption & keys-
- We offer AES-256 at rest. For Hosted customers we manage keys by default; for Redwood Private we support customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS & GCP KMS). Please let us know if Aurora requires customer-managed keys for production.

2) Logging & retention-
- Application logs: retained 90 days by default.
- Audit logs (authn/authz): retained 1 year and available as export.
- We can provide sample log snippets and a retention policy artifact.

3) Subservice providers / vendors-
- If Aurora requires disclosure of subprocessors, we will provide the current list (payment processor and cloud infra providers). Are you asking for a full vendor list or only those in-scope for PCI/PII processing?

4) Architecture & endpoints-
- We'll produce a redacted architecture diagram (network flows, public endpoints, where tokens are stored). Is a single diagram sufficient or do you need environment-separated diagrams (prod vs staging)?

5) SOC 2 report
- We can share a redacted SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; summary attached as referenced earlier (Redwood_SOC2-summary.pdf). If you send an NDA link or consume via your secure portal, we can push the full redacted report within 48 hours.

Proposed next action: 30-minute call to align on the answers above and confirm whether SIG Lite is acceptable. I've added a short proposed agenda: evidence list, key ownership, logging specifics, and handoff for procurement. Are you available Thu Jun 17 10:00-10:30am ET or Fri Jun 18 2:00-2:30pm ET?

If you prefer, we can also start populating SIG Lite fields and flag items that require attachments.

Regards,

Ben Carter
Principal Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
